purpose: Qualify all sealed S01/S06/S10 C08 frames with an independent route-conditioned support surface while retaining the frozen layered collision field and exact safety thresholds.

approval.scope: Create and execute exactly one non-overwrite C08 route-conditioned support corrective for 3 development worlds, 312 edges, 624 directed traversals, 25 windows and 4773 frames; zero LiDAR/model/checkpoint/graph/C09/C10/M-TARE reads.
approval.confirmation_reference: After implementation, complete read-only geometry/native proofs and a clean preflight were presented, the user explicitly replied 批准 to the one-shot formal geometry execution.

raw_sources: Three sealed C08 graph.json, splines.json and geometry_parameters.json development inputs bound by SHA-256 in the run spec.
Three sealed C08 trajectory NPZ and traversal JSON inputs bound by SHA-256 in the run spec.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local read-only Cano-derived development evidence. C09/C10, M-TARE, native LiDAR, model outputs and checkpoints are excluded from this geometry qualification.

sampling.rule: Freeze geometry before trajectory reads; preserve world, edge/traversal, route order, route arc and frame index. Freeze window membership at 80/128/258 frames and require all other 4307 graph/sensor poses to remain bitwise identical. Resolution evaluations are repeated audits, not new samples.

teacher.source: No semantic teacher. Downward support is the current traversal spline z plus the sealed per-world fta_distance_m; junction windows blend only independently retained incident edge support arcs with the existing C1 radial transition.
teacher.valid_mask: At all three collision resolutions every frame must have horizontal clearance >=0.8m, route-conditioned downward distance in [0.95,1.05]m and upward clearance >=0.8m; existing continuity and resolution identity must hold.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: No model or planner consumes this run. PASS only restores C08 causal replay eligibility and does not pass Gate 4.

split.historical_pollution_audit: Only the three C08 development geometries and sealed trajectories are readable; C09/C10 are listed only to enforce exclusion.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU only under a 4 GiB address-space cap; 150 serial collision patches, 14319 frame-resolution audits, 10309680 horizontal collision rays, 14319 upward collision rays and 14319 analytic support evaluations; zero GPU.

evidence.machine_metrics: 25 windows, 50 window-layer identities, 624 typed arc endpoints, 150 patch records, three corrected trajectories with explicit teacher/graph/sensor coordinates, a 4773-row audit and complete hashes.
evidence.complete_visual_review: Three complete per-world XY/XZ/safety figures plus serialized per-layer transition patches and seam/dispatch metrics.
evidence.failure_policy: Any drift, support ambiguity, non-incident merge, window conflict, seam/isolation/nonmanifold failure, window-exterior pose change, resolution disagreement, resource breach, failed frame or continuity regression seals FAIL; no tuning, deletion or retry.
